pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 3
   C. 6
   D. 5

2. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 22

6. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 1

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 60
   C. 38
   D. 30

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 7

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

12. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

13. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

15. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

16. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 7
   C. 18
   D. 6

17. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

18. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

20. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

22. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 10

23. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

24. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

25. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

26. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

27. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 25

28. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

29. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27

30. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 37
